caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate with two concentric decorative borders composed of star motifs. The outer border consists of green eight-pointed stars evenly spaced along the rim of the plate. The inner border, closer to the center of the plate, is made up of similar eight-pointed stars in red, also evenly spaced in a circle. The surface of the plate is lightly shaded in gray pencil, suggesting a three-dimensional form. Below the main top-down view of the plate, there is a simple cross-sectional diagram drawn in pencil, outlining the side profile of the plate and indicating a diameter of 9 inches with an annotated measurement. The background is a light beige color, and there are no additional objects or text within the drawing.
title: Plate
